generationRecords.prompt: Create transparent PNG artwork only for historical city-builder UI, 80% functional 20% medieval character. Use attached project's building art for PALETTE and brushwork only. Hand-painted clean pictogram icons, bold DARK INK BROWN outline, warm BONE/off-white and OAK brown fills, very low detail, no surrounding panels, no text labels, NO LETTERS, NO NUMBERS, no progress bars, no highlight or selection rectangles. No photographic texture. Maximum silhouette distinction when shrunk to 24px. All icons equally sized and centered within equal grid cells, generous empty spacing, no cell lines or background. exactly six icons in a 3-column 2-row regular grid, row-major: group of three people's bust silhouettes; single round rustic loaf with two broad scores; three stacked short oak logs; two angular pale grey rubble stones; stack of plain dull gold coins; blank parchment calendar with two binder loops and only a few square cutouts NO numbers NO lettering. Muted brick red is sole general accent. Green and blue ONLY for status symbols. Transparent background with genuine alpha, no checkerboard painted. Front-facing pictogram style, no complex illustration. Do not reproduce houses from reference. Output landscape canvas for grids or very wide landscape for single row.

processing.method: Equal-grid extraction; alpha >128 content bounds plus3px, discard alpha below32 and remap32..255, proportional Lanczos3 resize into84%cell then center, remove disconnected alpha specks smaller than0.5%largest component; no new pictogram drawing.
